en.headline: Centre for Health Protection investigates new Mpox case
en.dek: A 29-year-old man tested positive after developing symptoms, bringing this year's total to 30 cases as authorities step up vaccination and contact tracing.
body: The Centre for Health Protection of the Department of Health said today it is investigating a confirmed Mpox case involving a 29-year-old man who is in stable condition.

The patient developed a papule on his buttock on 28 September, followed by rashes on his limbs and buttock, fever and swollen lymph nodes. On 8 October, staff at an outreach vaccination service noticed the symptoms and arranged isolation treatment at Princess Margaret Hospital. Laboratory testing confirmed the presence of the Monkeypox virus.

According to information provided by the patient, he had high-risk sexual exposure with a man in Hong Kong during the incubation period. The centre is continuing its epidemiological investigation and will report the case to the World Health Organization.

Since 2022, Hong Kong has recorded 114 Mpox cases, all in males, of which 30 have been recorded this year, including 23 local cases. Since August there have been 21 new cases. The centre said most recent patients had not been vaccinated and that over half of recent cases involved partners met through dating apps. It has increased vaccination venues and outreach, and noted a more than 70 per cent rise in doses administered earlier this month compared with the same period last month.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心調查新增猴痘確診個案
zh.dek: 一名29歲男子出現病徵後確診，今年累計30宗個案，中心加強疫苗接種及接觸者追蹤。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心今日表示，正調查一宗猴痘確診個案，患者為29歲男子，目前情況穩定。
患者9月28日在臀部出現丘疹，其後四肢及臀部出現紅疹，並有發燒及淋巴結腫大。10月8日接受外展疫苗接種服務時，人員發現其病徵，安排到瑪嘉烈醫院隔離治療。臨床樣本證實對猴痘病毒呈陽性反應。
根據患者提供的資料，他於潛伏期內曾於香港與男子有高風險性接觸。中心正繼續進行流行病學調查，並會將個案通報世界衞生組織。
自2022年起本港累計錄得114宗猴痘個案，全部為男性；今年至今有30宗，其中23宗為本地個案。8月以來新增21宗。中心指近期多數患者未接種疫苗，超過一半個案透過交友應用程式尋找性伴侶。中心已增加接種地點及外展服務，並指本月初接種劑數較上月同期增加超過70%。
